item.title: US military refueling aircraft crashes in Iraq, Centcom says
item.description: The U.S. military announced Thursday that a refueling aircraft, a KC-135, crashed in western Iraq in an incident that was not caused by friendly or hostile fire. item.title: Gunman in Old Dominion University shooting served time for ISIS support, officials report
item.description: One person was killed and two others were hurt in a shooting at Old Dominion University on Thursday morning, according to officials at the Virginia school. The suspected gunman is also dead, the officials said.

item.title: Woman says car with 58 bundles of meth was gift from boyfriend
item.description: A woman who says she was on a shopping trip in a car her boyfriend recently bought for her is having to explain why 58 bundles of illicit drugs were hidden in the vehicle.

item.title: Ravinia Festival announces 2026 concert schedule
item.description: Notable acts coming through this summer include Paul Simon, Brandi Carlile, Chance the Rapper, Ricky Martin and Alabama Shakes.

item.title: Man who rammed his vehicle into Michigan synagogue was naturalized citizen from Lebanon, DHS says
item.description: An attacker armed with a rifle rammed his vehicle into one of the nation’s largest reform synagogues Thursday, driving through a hallway as security opened fire, fatally shooting him, authorities said.

item.title: How meteorologists and air traffic controllers team up for flight safety
item.description: The partnership was born from tragedy, a 1977 Southern Airlines plane crash. The weather was to blame.

item.title: Tornado victim found dead in damaged Aroma Park home, officials say
item.description: A person was found dead inside a home in Aroma Park Thursday afternoon, and authorities believe the person was a victim of Tuesday evening's tornadoes.

item.title: CTU pushing to cancel classes on May 1
item.description: The Chicago Teachers Union has not been shy about flexing its political muscle in recent years and now its leadership is demanding a day-off from school on May 1, wanting a day of demonstrations and events that largely align with progressive policies.
